messages.text: Free power? Then the Magic Miner 40T's 468 kWh a month costs you nothing — $799 buys a machine drawing for a full 3.125 BTC block every ten minutes, for years. Is this your first miner?

Yes — the 40T runs Harlo OS, and you just drop a stratum pool URL, worker and password into settings. It ships set to solo by default, but pool is a two-minute change, and payouts go straight to your own wallet, no exchange, no KYC.

Pointing it at a pool, or keeping the solo block shot?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Magic Miner 40T numbers for where you live.
